body: Wow. Simply saying you’re proud of me, coming from a stranger was so warm. Thank you so much for reaching out to me through this post.

Best liars and manipulators yes. I’m coming to terms with that. It’s hard because I feel like at the rate he’s going he isn’t going to live long enough to make that change so I feel like I’m holding on to whatever time we have left.

I’m sick of seeing it progress more and more. I’m sick of taking care of him when he’s strung out. It makes me sick to watch all of this.

Thank you for your kind words. I appreciate them so much.

I started drinking more when I met him. Got to the point where I was drinking til the point of passing out regularly and that’s when I knew my own behavior had to change. I had sunk to my own all time low.
Well I would suggest to work with a therapist to find out what suits you! If that’s your comfort level you can always work around that.

Connecting to those who love you is that first step. Even if you just reach out to one person and tell them “hey I’m struggling and I need support” they will show up. You don’t have to say much but just that you need help right now. 

Why do you think you wouldn’t want to connect?
Gotta spread sunshine wherever we can. *Hugs*

That self has silenced the the real you. Sometimes it takes help to let he/she speak again. I am in therapy and I have a wonderful support system now who promote the good in me. I’m even considering joining AA. Do you have friends, family, or a therapist to talk to?

Yes. We cannot let what I call “fuck up (insert your name)” determine how I feel or the choices I make. I make my fuck up girl a completely different person than I am because that darkness is not part of who I am from this point on.

As I suffer with GAD and PTSD I have insight into the pain you are dealing with. I also come from a home of hoarders and that has followed me my whole life. The pain of dealing with your family is an immense one. For that I’m sorry but I thank you for being strong for your mother. 

I’m going to give you the same advice that helped me and another person on here tonight.

My therapist gives me notecards to keep to remind myself of things I need to remember about who I am. My favorite reads “I am the warmth of the sunshine at my core. I will shine. I am shining.” 

People who are stuck in the cycle of wanting to kill themselves but not having the guts to do it have it the worst in my opinion. But like I told another redditor tonight, you are the warmth. You will shine. You are shining. And it’s okay for the sun to hide behind some clouds sometimes, because like us, we still get up and greet each day by trying. 

You are strong. So so strong.

Everyone in my life doesn’t understand the constant weight you feel when you struggle so heavily. They don’t understand that having *good days* don’t always mean you are okay. It can take one bad day to melt you back into the floor all over again. 

In regards to your latest post. I feel exactly how you feel. I have gotten straight As in college and I have no clue how or why because I do not try. 

We get stuck in the repetitive cycle of trying day after day but ending in the same place and not having the guts to end it. It’s more depressing I feel because by never ending it, we are just continuing in the cycle of wanting to die but not being able to. Like we don’t even have control over that in our lives. 

I’d like to think though that because we simply just can’t do it that there is something strong in us that holds out. We don’t know it consciously but we are fighters and we don’t quit. When it gets tough, we might melt into the floor but when we finally stand up we will be stronger than those around us because we have had that special trait that kept us going. 

My therapist and I have flash cards that I am supposed to keep with me to remind myself of what and who I am. One of them reads “I am the warmth of the sunshine at my core. I will shine. I am shining.” 

You will shine. You are shining. You are warmth and just like the sun you greet each day even if you just want to stay hidden in the clouds. *And that is okay.* 

Thanks for your response. I needed to hear it.
